description:
🎯 ATHX 2027: Gym Session B (Upper Power & Hypertrophy Deload)
Rationale: Adapted microcycle following Wed 21-15-9 Deadlifts (4,595 kg volume) + Box Jumps + Run. Deloads lumbar spine & posterior chain; maintains 104 kg bench press & upper MEV. Zero running/cardio today.

⚡ Warm-up (6–8 min):
• Thoracic foam rolling & cat-cow (lumbar mobility)
• Band pull-aparts & external shoulder rotations: 2 × 15
• Dead hangs from pull-up bar: 2 × 30s (spinal decompression)

🏋️ Working Sets & Target Weights:
1. Barbell Bench Press: 4 × 6–8 @ 75–82.5 kg (preserve 104 kg e1RM, zero spinal compression)
2. Weighted Pull-ups (or Strict Chin-ups): 4 × 6–8 @ Bodyweight + 10–15 kg
3. Chest-Supported DB Row: 3 × 10–12 @ 24–28 kg DBs (upper back volume, 0% lower back load)
4. Incline DB Flyes / Cable Triceps Pushdowns: 3 × 12–15
5. Hanging Leg / Knee Raises: 3 × 12–15 (core work + lumbar traction)

⏱️ Rest: 2–2.5 min on Bench & Pull-ups; 60–90s on accessories.
🚫 No running or flush cardio today (legs deloading for Friday CrossFit).
